s.n: Sparky's spirit fingers with honey mustard
s.note: Sparky Polastri's famous spirit fingers. Crumbed chicken tenders, honey mustard dip.
s.how: Season the flour, beat the eggs, and mix the panko with the parmesan and paprika. Dip each tender in flour, egg, then crumbs, and lay on a lined tray. Drizzle with oil and bake at 220C, turning once, until golden and cooked through. Stir the mustard, honey and mayo together and serve with the tenders.

s.note: The Toros' car wash fundraiser. San Diego fish tacos, cabbage, chipotle crema.
s.how: Stir the sour cream with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime. Whisk the flour, cumin, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter. Dip the fish and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp and golden. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with cabbage and fish, spoon over the crema and finish with coriander and lime.
shop: 500g firm white fish fillets, cut in strips@Seafood

s.note: Sparky's diet: now cut that in half. Grilled avocado halves, corn and lime salsa.
s.how: Char the corn cobs in a hot pan or on the barbecue, then cut off the kernels. Toss the corn with the tomato, onion, chilli, lime juice and salt. Brush the avocado cut sides with oil and grill face down for 2 minutes until marked. Fill each half with salsa, crumble over the feta and serve with chips to scoop.
shop: 4 ripe but firm avocados, halved and stoned@Produce

m.note: Home of the Rancho Carne Toros. Grilled skirt steak, pico de gallo, rice and beans.
m.how: Marinate the steak in the juice of 2 limes and the orange, the garlic, cumin, oil and salt for at least 20 minutes. Cook the rice, then stir through the warmed beans and a squeeze of lime. Mix the tomato, onion, coriander and remaining lime juice into a pico de gallo. Grill the steak over high heat, 3 minutes a side, rest it, then slice thinly across the grain. Serve with the rice and beans, pico and warm tortillas.

m.note: Nationals week in Daytona Beach. Roast pork, ham, Swiss, pickles, pressed hot.
m.how: Split the rolls and spread both sides with mustard. Layer the pork, ham, cheese and pickles, then close. Butter the outsides and press in a hot pan under a heavy pan, turning once, until crisp and melted. Cut on the diagonal and serve hot.

w.n: Spirit Stick churros with hot chocolate dip
w.note: The Spirit Stick never touches the ground. Cinnamon sugar churros, thick chocolate.
w.how: Bring the water, butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in the flour and beat until it leaves the pan. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy. Heat the cream, pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth. Pipe 12cm lengths into oil at 180C and fry in batches until golden. Roll in the remaining sugar mixed with the cinnamon and serve with the dip.
shop: 1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for rolling@Pantry

d.note: Brushing teeth with Cliff, not a word said. Lime, crushed mint and soda over ice.
d.how: Heat the sugar and water until dissolved, add half the mint and cool. Muddle the remaining mint with lime juice in 4 glasses. Add the strained syrup and ice and top with soda.
